_comment: Without water: rock with no aquifers, wet pockets, perched pools or springs (`Carvers.DRY`, which the hollows
an underground cuts answer to as well, so `dry rock` dries a great hall too), and on the whole Age the biomes
leaning dry and the sea leaning away. A cave under a sea still meets the sea, and the lava at the bottom stays.
It refuses wet rock as well as drying what is left, so `dry flooded rock` is two words that cannot both hold and
is charged as the contradiction it is. Offered too, yielding to anything the book says: drier air, less rain.
